manual.title: OmniSeam 3D Official User & Operations Manual
manual.subtitle: Step-by-Step Guide · 3D Viewport Controls & Self-Hosting Instructions
manual.qa_desc: Real-world cases, failure analysis, and authoritative solutions for CAD B-Rep solids, CFD fluid domain extraction, and cross-format conversions.
manual.qa_toc_title: 📋 Q&A Table of Contents (Click to Jump)
manual.qa_toc_desc: Top 10 Troubleshooting SOPs from recent engineering validation and testing:
manual.qa_select_prompt: Select a Q&A case to jump...
manual.qa_case1_toc: 1. CFD reports STEP/IGES is glTF mesh (.glb) not CAD solid
manual.qa_case1_title: ❓ CFD reports: "[xxx_polyheal.step] is a triangular mesh (glTF binary (.glb)), not a CAD solid. Fluid domain extraction requires STEP/IGES/BREP solid..." How to fix?
manual.qa_case1_reason1: 1️⃣ Target Format & Binary Header Mismatch: OmniSeam defaults to GLB target format. If Target Format was not explicitly switched to STEP in the settings panel, the output file payload is glTF 2.0 binary. Even if renamed to .step, the CFD kernel reads the first 4 bytes (Magic Bytes 'glTF') and immediately flags it as a mesh rather than an ISO-10303 plain text STEP entity.
manual.qa_case1_reason2: 2️⃣ Triangular Mesh (Facet B-Rep) vs. Analytical CAD B-Rep Solid: Source STL files consist of discrete triangles. CFD CAD fluid domain extraction algorithms rely on smooth analytical surfaces (cylinders, planes, NURBS) to perform solid Boolean subtraction. A facet STEP containing tens of thousands of tiny triangles can overwhelm CAD Boolean kernels.
manual.qa_case1_sol1: 💡 Solution 1 (CFD Recommended, Fastest & Most Reliable): Follow the prompt in your CFD software: click "Export as STL and import" or use the "Import Geometry / Surface Mesh" module designed specifically for triangular meshes and surface wrapping.
manual.qa_case1_sol2: 💡 Solution 2 (Use OmniSeam Built-in Wind Tunnel): Click "Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain Extraction" in OmniSeam's top header. It performs mesh-level Boolean domain extraction and exports closed fluid domain STL/OBJ ready for OpenFOAM/Fluent meshing.
manual.qa_case1_sol3: 💡 Solution 3 (Export ISO-10303-21 STEP Solid): If your workflow strictly requires STEP, select "STEP (.step)" in the right panel, switch to [Cloud Server] + enable [B-Rep Sewing] to invoke OpenCASCADE/FreeCAD for a valid MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP.
manual.qa_case2_toc: 2. STEP imported into CAD/CFD displays as Open Shell / 0 Faces
manual.qa_case2_title: ❓ Why does a STEP exported from STL report "Open Shell / 0 Faces / [0,0,0] Bounds" in CFD/CAD?
manual.qa_case2_desc: STL is a discrete triangular mesh (Polygon Facets), whereas industrial STEP (ISO 10303) requires continuous closed boundary topology (Manifold Solid). If the source STL has open holes (e.g. 158 boundary edges) or self-intersecting facets, strict CAD kernels (OpenCASCADE, Parasolid) cannot construct a closed volume and fall back to treating it as an "Unsewn Open Shell of Faces", causing solid face count to display as 0.
manual.qa_case2_solutions_title: 🛠️ 3-Step Workflow to Export 100% Watertight Closed CAD Solids (SOP):
manual.qa_case2_sol1: 1️⃣ Switch to [☁️ Cloud Server Node]: Pure in-browser execution only produces facetted wrappers; Cloud/Private nodes execute full FreeCAD/OpenCASCADE B-Rep sewing.
manual.qa_case2_sol2: 2️⃣ Select [💧 Forced Watertight Solid] strategy: Automatically patches boundary holes, resolves non-manifold self-intersections, and welds duplicate vertices.
manual.qa_case2_sol3: 3️⃣ Enable [B-Rep Topology Sewing]: In Expert Tuning, enable sewing with tolerance (0.001mm ~ 0.01mm) to fuse all analytical faces into an ISO-compliant Closed Solid.
manual.qa_case3_toc: 3. File Role & Purpose Mapping: Model Body (_omniseam) vs Fluid Domain (_fluid_domain)
manual.qa_case3_title: ❓ File Role & Purpose Mapping: What is the fundamental difference between Model Body (_omniseam.step) and Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain (_fluid_domain.step), and how to use them properly in CFD?
manual.qa_case3_why_title: 🔍 In-depth Analysis of File Roles & Geometry Meaning:
manual.qa_case3_reason1: 1️⃣ Model Solid Body (_omniseam.step / _polyheal.step) [Solid Part]: The physical object itself (e.g. metal fan blade, vehicle exterior, heat sink). Used for CAD assembly, structural FEA stress analysis, or 3D printing. In CFD, it serves ONLY as a boundary condition surface (No-slip Wall) or rotating MRF zone definition. It must NEVER be used directly as the fluid domain to simulate flow (which would physically simulate fluid flowing INSIDE the metal solid).
manual.qa_case3_reason2: 2️⃣ Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain (_fluid_domain.step / _fluid_domain.stl) [Fluid Cavity]: The external air/liquid space surrounding the part (the wind tunnel bounding box minus the solid part). This is the PRIMARY core file for CFD aerodynamic simulations, containing the outer Inlet, Outlet, Slip/Symmetry walls, and the internal negative wall of the object.
manual.qa_case3_reason3: 3️⃣ Visual & Polygon Surface Mesh (_polyheal.glb / _preview.stl) [Visual Rendering]: Discrete triangular mesh used for fast 3D web rendering, AR/VR inspection, or as the input source for CFD 'Surface Wrapping' workflows.
manual.qa_case3_solutions_title: 🛠️ Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for CFD Setup:
manual.qa_case3_sol1: 📌 Flow & Aerodynamic Analysis: Open or import the _fluid_domain file directly into your CFD software (Aetherflow, OpenFOAM, Fluent). Assign inlet velocity and outlet pressure, and generate a 3D volume mesh to solve the Navier-Stokes equations immediately without needing CAD boolean operations inside CFD.
manual.qa_case3_sol2: 📌 Structural Mechanics or Conjugate Heat Transfer (CHT): Load _omniseam as the solid domain ONLY when solving solid thermal conduction or thermo-mechanical stress, coupled with the fluid domain at the fluid-solid interface.
manual.qa_case4_toc: 4. Pure Client download downloaded as index.html anomaly
manual.qa_case4_title: ❓ Why does clicking "Download Finished File" download an index.html file instead?
manual.qa_case4_reason: In static hosting environments (such as Vercel) without a persistent backend, requesting relative URLs like /api/v1/tasks/{id}/download causes the Single Page App (SPA) router to intercept the request and return the index.html fallback page.
manual.qa_case4_sol1: 💡 Client has been upgraded to in-memory Blob instant download (binding blob: URLs directly to dynamic <a> tags).
manual.qa_case4_sol2: 💡 If running on older cached pages, press Ctrl+F5 (Cmd+Shift+R) to perform a hard refresh and purge cache.
manual.qa_case4_sol3: 💡 If using a custom private backend, verify in Backend Settings that node connectivity displays green.
manual.qa_case5_toc: 5. Why does 3D Viewport show a CAD icon HUD instead of 3D mesh?
manual.qa_case5_title: ❓ Why does uploading SolidWorks / Inventor / IFC display a CAD icon HUD instead of 3D geometry?
manual.qa_case5_reason: SolidWorks (.sldprt), Inventor (.ipt), and IFC are proprietary binary B-Rep CAD formats. Browsers cannot decode them client-side without proprietary licenses. To avoid the misleading TorusKnot placeholder of older versions, OmniSeam renders an informative CAD HUD card.
manual.qa_case5_sol1: 💡 Click "Unlock Dedicated Cloud Node" to connect to a free 16GB Hugging Face Space or local Docker (:8000).
manual.qa_case5_sol2: 💡 The backend FreeCAD/OCCT engine will tessellate proprietary B-Rep geometry and stream full 3D interactive graphics within seconds.
manual.qa_case5_sol3: 💡 Or export the model as STEP or STL in your original CAD software before uploading for instant offline in-browser preview.
manual.qa_case6_toc: 6. Hugging Face 16GB node connection times out or returns 503
manual.qa_case6_title: ❓ Why does testing connection to Hugging Face 16GB node time out or return 503?
manual.qa_case6_reason:
1. Cold Start: Free Spaces sleep after 48h of inactivity and require 30~60s to boot the FreeCAD container.
2. URL Format: Pasting the web page UI URL instead of the direct API endpoint URL.
3. Hardware selection: Incorrectly choosing ZeroGPU instead of CPU Basic.
manual.qa_case6_sol1: 💡 Open your Space URL in a new browser tab and wait until the status shows green "Running".
manual.qa_case6_sol2: 💡 Paste the URL into OmniSeam; our built-in Smart URL Normalizer will automatically format it to https://username-space.hf.space.
manual.qa_case6_sol3: 💡 When duplicating the Space template, verify Space Hardware is set to CPU Basic (2 vCPU · 16 GB · Free).
manual.qa_case7_toc: 7. Shared 3D project URL link returns page not found or invalid URL
manual.qa_case7_title: ❓ Why does opening a shared 3D project link show page not found or navigation error?
manual.qa_case7_reason: Older versions appended slogan text (e.g. "...#view from OmniSeam 3D") to the clipboard. Some messaging apps (Teams, LINE, Slack) encoded Chinese/special characters into the URL, breaking client-side router hash parsing.
manual.qa_case7_sol1: 💡 The share tool now copies 100% clean URLs without any appended text.
manual.qa_case7_sol2: 💡 If selecting manually, only copy the pure https:// URL string.
manual.qa_case7_sol3: 💡 Opening the clean URL completely restores camera angles, comparison mode, and geometry audit states.
manual.qa_case8_toc: 8. Does Wind Tunnel inherit settings from the right panel?
manual.qa_case8_title: ❓ Does clicking 'Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain Extraction' inherit settings from the right-hand panel (e.g., Cloud Server, Geometry Strategy, Fine-Tuning Drawer)?
manual.qa_case8_reason1: 1️⃣ Compute Mode (Cloud Server vs. Pure Client) [INHERITED]: The system inherits the selected compute mode. If set to Pure Client, extraction runs locally in WebAssembly; if switched to Cloud Server, it dispatches to the backend Python/OpenCASCADE geometry engine for boolean subtraction.
manual.qa_case8_reason2: 2️⃣ Geometry Strategy & Fine-Tuning [INDEPENDENT]: The right panel strategy (Watertight, Intent-Preserving, etc.) governs general format conversion and repair. Wind Tunnel runs an independent CFD aerodynamic envelope and boolean subtraction pipeline with its own inlet/outlet/margin factors and boolean mode (auto / manifold_mesh / solid_cad).
manual.qa_case8_sol1: 📌 Switch to Cloud Server for complex meshes: Pure client WASM has browser memory constraints. For dense meshes or complex aerodynamics, the cloud node ensures robust and fast boolean processing.
manual.qa_case8_sol2: 📌 Adjust CFD domain parameters inside the modal: Configure inlet (2.0x), outlet (5.0x), and margin (2.0x) factors directly in the Wind Tunnel modal without adjusting right-panel settings.
manual.qa_case9_toc: 9. Precondition Impact of Mesh Quality on Wind Tunnel Extraction
manual.qa_case9_title: ❓ Why does Wind Tunnel extraction fail, produce empty domains, or display non-manifold intersections? What is the impact of geometry quality and how to heal it?
manual.qa_case9_reason1: 1️⃣ Boolean Subtraction Principle: Wind tunnel extraction subtracts the solid model from a flow bounding box. This boolean operation strictly requires the model to be a closed, manifold watertight volume.
manual.qa_case9_reason2: 2️⃣ Fatal Impact of Holes & Self-Intersections: If the raw STL/OBJ has open boundaries, non-manifold edges, or self-intersecting facets, the boolean engine cannot distinguish fluid interior from solid exterior, leading to boolean failure or degenerate geometry.
manual.qa_case9_sol1: 💡 Step 1 (Pre-heal with right panel): In the right panel, select 'Watertight Manifold' strategy and set sewing tolerance to 0.01mm ~ 0.1mm in the expert drawer.
manual.qa_case9_sol2: 💡 Step 2 (Generate clean watertight model): Click 'Convert Now'. OmniSeam will close holes, repair normals, and weld boundaries into a clean solid (export as STEP or STL).
manual.qa_case9_sol3: 💡 Step 3 (Run Wind Tunnel on healed model): Load the healed watertight model and run 'Wind Tunnel Extraction' for a 100% guaranteed successful boolean extraction.
manual.qa_case10_toc: 10. CFD 15-Second CAD Bounds Probe Mechanism (Root Cause & Best Practices)
manual.qa_case10_title: ❓ Why does importing a STEP file into CFD "CAD Fluid Domain Extraction" trigger a 15-second timeout or probe failure? What is the root cause and standard workflow?
manual.qa_case10_why_title: 🔍 Root Cause & Mechanism Analysis of the 15-Second Geometry Probe:
manual.qa_case10_reason1: 1️⃣ Necessity of Geometry Probing (Probe Bounds): Before constructing a wind tunnel, CFD software must query the exact 3D bounding box (X/Y/Z min & max) and topological entity counts (Volumes & Surfaces) to calculate proportional wind tunnel extents and characteristic mesh size lc.
manual.qa_case10_reason2: 2️⃣ 15-Second Safety Guard (Crash Prevention): To prevent malformed, corrupted, or abnormally huge STEP files from freezing or crashing the CFD GUI, the CFD core launches an isolated sub-process with OpenCASCADE (-parse_and_exit) and enforces a strict 15-second timeout (waitForFinished(15000)). If it exceeds 15 seconds, the process is forcefully terminated (kill) to protect user stability.
manual.qa_case10_reason3: 3️⃣ The Root Culprit (Faceted STEP): Standard CAD solids from SolidWorks/Fusion 360 contain only tens or hundreds of analytical faces, which OpenCASCADE probes in under 1 second. However, a Faceted STEP converted naively from an STL mesh contains tens or hundreds of thousands of tiny planar facets. OpenCASCADE's topological traversal undergoes exponential computational explosion, easily exceeding 15 seconds and triggering the safety kill.
manual.qa_case10_solutions_title: 🛠️ 2 Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) to Avoid Timeout & Extract Fluid Domains:
manual.qa_case10_sol1: 💡 Branch A (For STL/OBJ/Mesh models, Strongly Recommended): Do NOT force-convert to a 100k-face Faceted STEP! ① Method 1: Click 'Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain Extraction' in OmniSeam's top toolbar to perform mesh-level boolean subtraction and export fluid domain STL/OBJ in seconds; ② Method 2: In your CFD software, use 'Import Geometry / Surface Mesh' or Surface Wrapping, which natively processes triangular meshes and completely bypasses OpenCASCADE CAD B-Rep parsing.
manual.qa_case10_sol2: 💡 Branch B (When STEP Solid extraction is strictly required): In OmniSeam's conversion panel, switch to [☁️ Cloud Server Node] and select [💧 Forced Watertight Solid]. In Expert Tuning, enable [B-Rep Sewing] and mesh simplification to decimate facet count and sew them into a genuine ISO-compliant MANIFOLD_SOLID_BREP. A valid CAD solid will pass CFD's 15-second probe in less than 1 second!

manual.cad_solution1_title: 🛠️ 3-Step Workflow to Export 100% Watertight Closed CAD Solids:

manual.cad_issue2_desc:

• _fluid_domain.step: The extracted air cavity around the part (wind tunnel box subtracted by the part), dedicated to CFD aerodynamic flow and pressure analysis.
manual.quickstart_banner_desc: OmniSeam 3D features intelligent format detection and autonomous surface-healing engines. Whether you are a 3D printing maker, mechanical engineer, or 3D artist, convert models in seconds.
manual.step1_desc: Supports STEP, IGES, SolidWorks, STL, OBJ, 3MF, IFC, DXF and more. Automatic topology inspection runs instantly.
manual.step2_desc: 1-click choose between [🛡️ Smart Lossless Fidelity], [💧 Forced Watertight Solid], or [🔍 Raw Passthrough], or expand Expert Tuning for custom parameters.

manual.fidelity_desc: OmniSeam 3D strictly adheres to the principle of Zero-Modification Geometric Fidelity: clean models pass through with 100% bit-level preservation, never applying arbitrary distortions.
manual.fidelity_passthrough_desc: Before modifying any 3D model, the engine executes non-destructive diagnostic gating. If the model is already watertight without self-intersections or non-manifold edges, it passes through untouched with original vertex coordinates, topologies, and feature lines 100% preserved.
manual.fidelity_intent_desc: Using boundary loop curvature analysis, dihedral continuity, and opening angle evaluation, the engine accurately distinguishes intentional through-holes/ports from defective holes. Intentional openings are protected and never blindly closed.
manual.fidelity_tier1: 1️⃣ Sub-Micron Topology Welding: Welds micro-gap split vertices (<0.001mm) without affecting macro-geometry.
manual.fidelity_tier2: 2️⃣ Advancing Front Triangulation (AFT) & Non-Manifold Untangling: Smoothly fills genuine defect holes while maintaining boundary normal continuity.
manual.fidelity_tier3: 3️⃣ Volumetric SDF Dual Contouring: For severely degraded/fragmented models, reconstructs a 100% watertight solid within tight <0.005mm deviation bounds.
manual.fidelity_cad_title: 📐 RANSAC CAD Reverse Engineering & Exact STEP B-Rep
manual.fidelity_cad_desc: Mesh-to-STEP conversion utilizes RANSAC primitive fitting (planes, cylinders, cones, spheres, tori) to extract exact analytical B-Rep boundary surfaces and stitch them into true ISO 10303 CAD solids with zero fake fallback geometry.
manual.preset_3dprint_desc: Forcefully fills all open boundary holes to output a 100% closed watertight solid, preventing slicer leak errors (Suited for: Cura, PrusaSlicer, Bambu, 3D Printing, Tooling).
manual.preset_game_desc: Protects designed openings and CFD pipes, only heals non-manifold & normal bugs. 100% pass-through for healthy models (Suited for: SolidWorks, ANSYS, Fusion, Rhino, Blender).

manual.slicer_question: Why do slicers like Cura, PrusaSlicer, or Bambu Studio report 'Non-manifold edges' or 'Model is not watertight'?
manual.slicer_watertight_desc: Every triangle edge must be shared by exactly 2 triangles. If shared by 1, it is an open hole; if shared by more than 2, it is non-manifold, causing slicers to fail when determining internal vs external volume.
manual.slicer_overhang_desc: In FDM 3D printing without supports, overhang structures beyond 45° collapse under gravity. OmniSeam 3D marks overhang areas (mm²) and estimates support volume (cm³) in the audit report.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Security Statement
privacy.subtitle: Enterprise Confidentiality · 100% Client-Side Offline · Zero Data Retention
privacy.banner_title: 100% Absolute Confidentiality Guarantee for your 3D CAD Files
privacy.banner_desc: 3D models represent your most critical intellectual property. OmniSeam 3D is architected around Pure Client offline execution and isolated private compute spaces to ensure zero data leakage.
privacy.pillar1_desc: Standard meshes and CAD files process entirely inside your browser via WebAssembly. 0% network file transfer.
privacy.pillar2_desc: We never log or transmit model filenames, dimensions, vertices, or geometric metadata.
privacy.pillar3_desc: Dedicated nodes on Hugging Face Spaces or local Docker run in isolated sandboxes with ephemeral storage.
privacy.pillar4_desc: The complete codebase is publicly open on GitHub under MIT/Apache-2.0. No hidden backdoors or vendor lock-in.
privacy.fidelity_guarantee_desc: We strictly adhere to zero artificial fallback, zero silent downsampling, and zero destructive modification. All micro-scale deviations are transparently reported in the audit metrics.

wind_tunnel.title: Wind Tunnel Fluid Domain Extraction
wind_tunnel.subtitle: CFD Aerodynamic Fluid Domain Boolean Extraction
wind_tunnel.desc_body: Directly in-app using OpenCASCADE / Manifold Boolean engines, subtract the solid body from an expanded bounding flow domain to generate a watertight fluid cavity without needing external CAD tools.
